about: Match music round 5 (2026-11-09). The operator: "i need at least 2 tracks for each combo. can you come up with some new unique tracks?" and "16-bit tracks are not a requirement anymore. we're just trying to generate good music." Every slot with fewer than two live tracks (RG none; B, BG, G, GU, GW, R, RW, U, WB, WU one) gets three new ideas, RG four, and the slots at two get one more for variety. Only the two kinds that kept: battle in costume (one distinct genre fought out, warm soft-topped mix, through-composed with a breakdown) and a place you are in (music written as heard from far off, laid 6 dB under its beds). No genre repeats an earlier round.
